CF4_CORAS_MARKS.json.scope: Eight compiled conditional 2MRS field draws on 8,885 6dFGSv rows and two actual linked-group holdouts. CF3-calibrated history and selection limitations remain.

CF4_FIELD_HOLDOUT.json.scope: 25 shared field-scale/offset scenarios on two match-group linkages; working predictions with independent calibration outstanding.

CF4_H05_AXES.json.scope: Literature directions placed on the registered selected CF4 window estimates and 2MRS support, with explicit estimator and covariance limits.

CF4_LITERATURE_H05.md.scope: Map fitted estimands, windows, field priors, calibration and held-out evidence in competing CF4 literature. Physical agreement and H05 acceptance require a matched empirical comparison.

COMMANDER_ACQUISITION_00002.json.scope: One additional Commander raw noise realization downloaded with bounded bytes and verified identity; this input does not qualify the null.

COMMANDER_DOWNLOAD_PLAN.json.scope: Release object/byte inventory; counts do not represent a calibrated ensemble.

COMMANDER_MERGED.json.scope: Matched estimator and unique raw IDs across the small Commander bank. Rank resolution remains finite and foreground transfer is unqualified.

COMMANDER_PAIR_00001.json.scope: Independent R105 run for index 00001 using the same masked transfer; use unique source indices in the merged bank.

COMMANDER_TRANSFER.json.scope: Release-specific masked real-sky and two-MC signed template injection, a bounded B03 operator check. Foreground/null and physical family likelihood remain unresolved.

CORAS_BINARY_REPLAY.json.scope: Independent CORAS build generated byte-matched conditional mean and seed-1 residual fields at 21,860 source positions.

CORAS_BUILD_RECEIPT.json.scope: Compiled the identified external CORAS source with a source-pinned driver; scientific field output is counted separately.

CORAS_H02.json.scope: CORAS common-support 2MRS field projections at reduced numerical settings. FFT-dependent draws require covariance qualification; this is not a Manticore ensemble.

CROSS_RESULTS.json.scope: Actual CF4 selected geometry and bounded missing velocities, propagated Gaia/radio summaries, numerical radiation invariants and an analytic exceptional Lie rank constraint.

GAIA_FRAME_PARITY.json.scope: Joint registered-shell magnetic-frame curvature and cross-row jackknife sensitivity.

NATIVE_OPTICAL_REFINEMENT.json.scope: Same-configuration photon-cell refinement and exact R104 comparison on VIIh/IX.

P1_ORDERING.json.scope: Minimal common KL reweighting of 2048 coupled apparent-CF4 draws to tie strict four-window ordering.

RADIO_MATCHED_REFITS.json.scope: Paired nonlinear NVSS peak/integrated spatial deletion refits across 166 and 594 blocks.

REC_OBSERVER_REDSHIFT.json.scope: Finite-observer redshift and opacity in the signed, non-tilted LRS-I REI sample; exterior and other families unqualified.

SOLVER_192.json.scope: Two additional actually executed N=192 cases, finite VI_-1/9 and FLRW configurations.

SOLVER_AXES_PILOT.json.scope: Bounded solver refinement pilot on identified configurations; no calibrated family attribution.

SOLVER_COMMON_TIMES.json.scope: VI_-1/9 on a nested 48/96/192 grid at common times, P4/L4. Both refinements lower the measured residual on 46 of 48 endpoints.
